id: title:Gilbert09:stop failing on a raced bucket creation retry

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion reliability: P1.F1.H1 implements a race-condition safeguard for S3 bucket creation, while P1.F2.H2 adds tests for this behavior.
review.reason: P1.F1.H1 adds a try/except block around S3 bucket creation, checking the error code. If the error is not BucketAlreadyOwnedByYou, it re-raises, preventing false-positive failures when multiple warehouse ingestion jobs attempt to create the same S3 bucket concurrently. P1.F2.H2 adds unit tests for this behavior. This is a substantive, bounded correctness improvement.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the existence of concurrent warehouse ingestion jobs; without this, the safeguard is not exercised. No evidence of actual incidents or adoption is provided.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a try/except around s3_client.create_bucket and checks the error code; if the error is not BucketAlreadyOwnedByYou, it re-raises. This prevents treating a race-condition failure as a permanent error.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent false-positive failures when multiple warehouse ingestion jobs attempt to create the same S3 bucket concurrently, allowing the system to recognize that the bucket exists even if the creation call fails due to a race.

observations.behavior: Adds a helper function to construct a ClientError with a specific code, and imports the new ensure_bucket_exists function.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds unit tests for the new bucket existence and creation behavior, including tests for the race condition and other error codes.
